# [CS032] Hardcoded Secret (hardcoded-secret)

An API key, private key or similar credential is embedded in the source.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-798](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/798.html) |
| **OWASP** | A07:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Provider-specific patterns and an entropy check find credentials such as cloud keys and tokens. Anything committed to a repository should be considered leaked: rotate it and load it from the environment or a secret manager.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
const stripeKey = "sk_live_51H..."
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
stripeKey := os.Getenv("STRIPE_API_KEY")
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [hardcoded-secret]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    hardcoded-secret: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore hardcoded-secret -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** hardcoded-secret
```
